milestones.title: Quote Manager integration
milestones.notes: Implement the documented read-only Quote Manager API for quotes, sales orders, suppliers, warehouses, and other supported commerce data. Target correlation with Autotask, vendor-cost reconciliation, ConnectBooster, and client profitability workflows.

milestones.title: Datto SaaS Protection integration
milestones.notes: Implement supported Datto SaaS Protection REST API access for customer/domain, seat/license, and backup-status intelligence. Read-only backup assurance first; any seat License/Unlicense/Pause operations must be separate governed actions.

milestones.title: BullPhish ID integration
milestones.notes: Investigate supported BullPhish ID API/integration surfaces. A Graphus API-key integration is documented, but a general-purpose public BullPhish API has not yet been confirmed. Do not build against undocumented endpoints; first obtain an official supported API contract or use supported downstream integration data.

milestones.title: UniView integration
milestones.notes: Review and implement the UniView Public API using OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Evaluate UniView as a canonical backup-provider surface across supported Unitrends/Datto/Spanning services before creating product-specific duplicate integrations.

milestones.title: INKY integration
milestones.notes: Investigate INKY's supported integration surfaces, prioritizing the documented KSIEM/SaaS Alerts integration and its API-key/webhook event stream. Prefer consuming supported SaaS Alerts/KSIEM telemetry where it avoids a separate polling connector.

milestones.title: Spanning Backup integration
milestones.notes: Implement the documented Spanning API for supported user/license, shared-drive, backup, and export/recovery-related operations. Start with read-only protection/license assurance; recovery/export or license mutations require governed execution.

milestones.title: myITprocess integration
milestones.notes: Review and implement the documented myITprocess REST API/Swagger surface. Target strategic/alignment data, recommendations, organizations/sites, and correlation with Autotask, IT Glue, Compliance Manager, and Jason management workflows as the API supports.

milestones.title: Kaseya MDR integration
milestones.notes: Investigate Kaseya MDR API and outbound webhook integration. Settings > API provides API identity/key, Partner ID, and approved webhook-domain governance, but endpoint, payload, subscription, and event schemas were not found in the governance page. Obtain the official supported API/webhook contract before implementation.

milestones.title: Kaseya SIEM integration
milestones.notes: Investigate Kaseya SIEM API and outbound webhook integration. Settings > API provides API identity/key, Partner ID, and approved webhook-domain governance, but endpoint, payload, subscription, and event schemas must be obtained from supported product documentation before implementation.

milestones.title: Cloudflare Radar Internet outage intelligence integration
milestones.notes: Integrate the Cloudflare Radar API as a read-only external evidence source for ISP/ASN and geographic outage/anomaly context. Use it to corroborate suspected ISP incidents, map affected providers/ASNs, and correlate regional events across AOT clients. Do not treat Radar alone as proof of a client outage; combine with RIPE Atlas, AOT-controlled AWS probes, DRMM/Datto Networking state, and cross-client observations.

milestones.title: RIPE Atlas distributed external reachability integration
milestones.notes: Integrate RIPE Atlas as an independent multi-network measurement source for ping, traceroute, DNS, TLS, and related reachability checks. Use distributed probes to corroborate whether a client public endpoint/circuit is unreachable from multiple external networks and to support outage classification. Establish per-site expected-test profiles so intentional ICMP/service filtering is not misclassified as an outage.

milestones.title: AOT-controlled AWS WAN probe infrastructure
milestones.notes: Build AOT-controlled external WAN probes in AWS for fast deterministic reachability and diagnostics. Start with Route 53 health checks where suitable and add lightweight probe instances for ICMP, TCP connect, DNS, TLS handshake, traceroute, latency, packet-loss, and route-change evidence. Use at least two AWS regions for independent perspective. Feed results into the Server/Site Offline playbook alongside Cloudflare Radar, RIPE Atlas, DRMM/Datto Networking, and Jason cross-client ISP correlation.
